title: Billing Desk Guidance — Cardinal DriveSense Monthly Mileage Charges and Adjustments
content:
Applies to the two pay-per-mile programs of Cardinal DriveSense: Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In.

## Rule

Under a pay-per-mile program the vehicle's rated premium is reduced to the program's base rate percentage as a fixed base, and the miles driven each calendar month are charged at the program's per-mile rate, counting no more than the program's daily mile cap for any one day; the charge is rounded to the cent and billed with the next installment. Days without data are estimated on the average daily miles over the last 30 days and replaced by actual data when it arrives. An odometer correction is accepted within the program's odometer correction window after the charge it corrects and lowers that charge; a mileage charge is adjusted only once for each reason.

| Program | Base rate (share of rated premium) | Per-mile rate | Daily mile cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 45% | 6.4 cents | 250 miles |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 42% | 5.9 cents | 250 miles |

The other four programs are not pay-per-mile: no per-mile rate (0 cents), no daily cap (0 miles), and the base rate is 100% of the rated premium.

## Defining the monthly charge

- **Chargeable miles for the month** are the total, over every day of the calendar month, of the lesser of the miles driven that day and the daily mile cap.
- **The mileage charge** is the chargeable miles multiplied by the per-mile rate in cents, divided by 100 to give dollars, and rounded once, to the cent, on that monthly total.
- The charge is posted once per enrollment per billing month and billed with the next installment.

## Worked example (hypothetical month)

A 30-day month: on 28 days the vehicle is driven 30 miles a day, on one day 410 miles, and on one day not at all.

| Step | Miles Mobile | Miles Plug-In |
|---|---|---|
| 28 days at 30 miles | 840 | 840 |
| The 410-mile day, counted at the 250-mile cap | 250 | 250 |
| The day not driven | 0 | 0 |
| Chargeable miles | 1,090 | 1,090 |
| Multiplied by the rate | 6,976 cents | 6,431 cents |
| Mileage charge | $69.76 | $64.31 |

Rounding: on Miles Plug-In, 1,093 chargeable miles multiplied by 5.9 cents is 6,448.7 cents, which is $64.487 and is charged as $64.49.

Fixed base: on a hypothetical rated premium of $900.00 for the term, the fixed base is 45% of it, $405.00, on Miles Mobile, and 42% of it, $378.00, on Miles Plug-In.

## Mileage adjustments

A posted mileage charge is lowered by a mileage adjustment, which records the miles removed and the amount credited. The reasons are:

| Reason | What it does |
|---|---|
| Odometer correction | Lowers the charge it corrects; accepted within the program's odometer correction window after that charge |
| Daily-cap correction | Lowers a charge that counted a day above the daily mile cap |
| Outage estimate replaced by actual data | Lowers a charge whose miles for days without data were estimated, once the actual data for those days arrives |

A mileage charge is adjusted only once for each reason: one charge may carry an odometer correction and a daily-cap correction, but not two odometer corrections.

Odometer window, hypothetical dates: both pay-per-mile programs accept an odometer correction within 30 calendar days after the charge; a correction raised 12 days after the charge is within it; one raised 45 days after the charge is not.
